title: baal-nf identifies motif-disrupting variants that decrease transcription factor binding affinity
authors: Breeshey Roskams-Hieter; Øyvind Almelid; Chris P Ponting
one_liner_zh: 该文用ChIP-seq数据识别等位基因不平衡的TF结合位点变异，虽涉及TF-DNA结合亲和力，但主要基于测序统计而非AI或物理模拟建模，方法可借鉴但深度不足。
abstract: Human traits vary in part due to genetically-determined change of transcription factor (TF) binding affinity within gene regulatory regions. However, few trait-causal variants or mechanisms are known. Here we propose 1,960 variants as strong candidates for causally altering human traits. They were discovered by baal-nf which uses ChIP-sequencing data to identify allelic imbalance at heterozygous sites (‘allele-specific binding sites’; ASBs) within affinity-concordant positions within TF- and/or co-factor binding motifs. These variants are evolutionarily conserved, and enriched for trait associations and gene expression QTLs. baal-nf and these high-quality ASBs now allow trait variation due to altered TF binding to be investigated.
abstract_zh: 人类性状的差异部分源于基因调控区域内转录因子（transcription factor, TF）结合亲和力的遗传决定变化。然而，已知的性状因果变异或机制很少。在此，我们提出1,960个变异作为因果性改变人类性状的强候选者。这些变异通过baal-nf发现，该工具利用ChIP测序数据识别杂合位点上的等位基因不平衡（‘等位基因特异性结合位点’；ASBs），这些位点位于TF和/或辅因子结合基序内的亲和力一致位置。这些变异在进化上保守，并富集于性状关联和基因表达数量性状位点（QTLs）。baal-nf及这些高质量的ASBs现在使得因TF结合改变导致的性状变异得以研究。
